why: Every required item was cited, and the answer also cited an ID that no item hashes to. Item IDs are content-derived, so an ID nothing produces is a typo or a fabrication -- and either way it reads as provenance to any report that counts citations instead of resolving them. The remedy is the opposite of the missing case: stop citing what does not exist. This case must NOT emit required_citation_missing, or the operator is told to cite evidence they already cited.
